reliefs.reasoning: The respondent has partially complied with the consent terms by paying Rs. 27,00,000 out of Rs. 1,50,00,000 and has not submitted any justified reasons for non-compliance, hence directed to refund the balance amount.

There is a delay in handing over possession as per the registered agreement for sale. The respondent has not mentioned sufficient reason for the delay. Allottees are entitled to seek interest for delayed possession under Section 18 of the RERA Act.

The project is being transferred to another developer (M/s. Shapoorji Pallonji), so the claim cannot be decided at this stage. Appropriate decision will be taken on merits after completion of transfer proceedings.
